SUI-EUR.summary: No current SUI network incident, security event, exchange disruption, or regulatory action was found that materially changes immediate spot-entry risk. A routine supply unlock is scheduled around September 30–October 1, but its reported size is modest versus circulating supply.

facts.fact: Sui’s official status page reports all mainnet services operational and no incidents from September 13 through September 27, 2026. ([status.sui.io](https://status.sui.io/?utm_source=openai))

Independent unlock trackers show a forthcoming late-September/October 1 release: Tokenomist lists 13.26M SUI, or 0.32% of released supply, on October 1; DefiLlama lists smaller September 30 cliff components. This is a supply-overhang item to monitor, but not material on its reported scale for this immediate signal. ([tokenomist.ai](https://tokenomist.ai/wenunlocks/sui?utm_source=openai))

The latest official Sui posts located were product/developer updates, including real-time GraphQL subscriptions on September 21, 2026; no adverse protocol announcement was identified in the review.
